Ethan / Alex — adding some operational context and a concrete runbook snippet.

TL;DR: Recommend we stage with a KV-cache proxy in front of the runtime egress and run a 2-hour synthetic alongside production traffic. This reduces blast radius and gives us deterministic hit-rate metrics. See runbook-snippets.md for commands.

Operator checklist (staging canary):
- Preflight (T-48h): Ensure KMS routing policy allows crypto egress to Stratus HSM endpoints. Confirm KMS->HSM IPs are exempt from NAT for audit chaining.
- T-1h: Push traffic-shadowing rule; start a low-volume synthetic (10 RPS) that exercises cold and warm cache flows.
- T+30m: Validate KV cache hit-rate >= 65% and p50 latency <= 18ms.
- T+2h: Collect traces and produce an incident-free signal before expanding to 50%.

Runbook notes: we should avoid terminating TLS at the demarc unless Stratus provides an agreed CA and we have shared cert rotation. If they can only mirror encrypted traffic, we'll rely on application-level tracing and token-level correlators.

Attached: runbook-snippets.md (commands + expected outputs), short ACL checklist.
